value.name: Asha notices earlier timestamp
value.description: Asha sees that the time on the floor is earlier than the version she gave Whitfield by nearly forty minutes and keeps her reaction hidden.
evidence: earlier than the version she had given Whitfield by nearly forty minutes, and she registered it without moving her face.

value.name: Devin realizes Asha came prepared
value.description: Devin watches Asha register the discrepancy and understands she may have come to hear the truth rather than be protected from it.
evidence: He watched her register it, and she understood from the way his shoulders dropped a fraction that he had not been sure, until he said it aloud, whether she had come here to be told that or to be spared it.

value.name: Asha releases briefcase and speaks
value.description: Asha loosens her grip on the briefcase and tells Devin the exact story she gave Whitfield about the corrected document and the missed call.
evidence: Asha let her fingers loosen on the briefcase handle one at a time, the leather settling against her thigh, and kept her eyes on his.

"Five-oh-six," she said. "That's what I gave Whitfield half an hour ago. I told him you corrected the document at five-oh-six Monday afternoon, and I told him I didn't return your five forty-three call last night because I wanted the account to land without us having talked first."
value.time_hint: Monday afternoon / last night / half an hour ago

value.name: Asha exposes the forty-minute gap
value.description: Asha makes the forty-minute difference between the two timestamps explicit, leaving the discrepancy visible between them.
evidence: The number sat in the kitchen with his four-eighteen, the nearly forty minutes between them visible now in a way neither of them could walk back

value.name: Devin accepts the gap cannot be closed
value.description: Devin realizes Asha is not asking him to reconcile the discrepancy and remains physically still.
evidence: she watched his face register that she had not come to ask him to close the gap.
He did not move from where he stood on the linoleum

value.name: Asha withholds further engagement
value.description: Asha deliberately leaves the space between them open and refuses to ask Devin anything further.
evidence: and she did not fill the space she had just opened.
she was not going to ask him anything

value.name: Asha asserts control over the morning
value.description: Asha recognizes that she has already used the crucial part of the morning, implying she has acted strategically before this confrontation.
